header.model: ICE (Impact x Confidence x Ease), with RICE shown
header.funnel_note: Open funnel: GA4 counts every user who fired each event, in any order.

weakest_step.why: Activation (booking page published) fell from 63.5% to 54.0% (z = -5.16), 136.7 fewer activations, and mobile activates at 49.5%, 17.3 activations short of the overall rate. Together about 62 purchases per 28 days at 40.2% downstream; estimate.

tests.test: Homepage button text: 'Get started' vs 'Create your booking page'
tests.lesson: Copy that names the outcome beat a generic button by 17.57% on the homepage (p = 0.0026).
tests.next_step: Shipped. Carry the outcome angle into the homepage headline (I-04).

tests.lesson: Fewer onboarding emails lowered activation from 64.1% to 56.1%; new accounts need more guidance, not less.
tests.next_step: Rolled back. Test more guidance in the product (I-02).

tests.test: Customer quotes on the in-app upgrade screen
tests.lesson: Quotes on the upgrade screen moved purchase +8.85%, but this sample could only see a 23.5% lift, so the result says little either way.
tests.next_step: Retest only as part of a bolder upgrade-screen change, at a lift the traffic can see.
